review_evidence: README states the project translates definitions between Coq and Lean and its checked artifact is a toy instruction-set architecture and example assembly programs intended as formal specifications.
The four Lean files include the ISA state/instruction/program definitions and two theorems characterizing halting behavior, rather than only translation tooling.
The formal ISA model is independently useful specification prior art even though the surrounding experiment studies LLM-assisted translation.
summary: Reviewed CoqLeanTranslation; retain its cross-prover ISA specification and checked behavior theorems.
